actions.command:
/usr/bin/bash -lc "salloc --account=bgun-dtai-gh --partition=ghx4-interactive \\
  --nodes=1 --ntasks=1 --cpus-per-task=1 --gpus-per-node=1 \\
  --mem=32G --time=02:00:00 \\
  srun --cpu-bind=none bash -lc '
    set -euo pipefail
    umask 007
    cd /u/gkerex/project/gval-usability-m6/codex
    source scripts/load_environment.sh deltaai-aarch64
    export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
    export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"\"
    gval doctor
    gval conformance --split-id rc300_reduced_v1 --tier quick
    gval check-adapter persistence --split-id rc300_reduced_v1 --device cpu
    gval_run_dir="'$(gval evaluate --request adapters/persistence/run_request.json '"\\
      --split-id rc300_reduced_v1 --split validation --tier quick --device cpu \\
      | tee /dev/stderr \\
      | python -c \"import json, sys; lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines(); result = json.loads(lines[-1]); assert result[\\\"ok\\\"]; print(result[\\\"run_dir\\\"])\")
    gval verify \""'$gval_run_dir"
    python -c "import json, pathlib, sys; record = json.loads((pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]) / '"\\\"run.json\\\").read_text()); print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in record.items() if any(s in k for s in (\\\"environment\\\", \\\"training\\\", \\\"attest\\\", \\\"checkpoint\\\"))}))\" \""'$gval_run_dir"
  '"'"
